data.one_liner: Client for ASP.NET Core SignalR, supports WebSocket and SSE across Dart platforms
data.what_it_does: Provides a Dart implementation of the SignalR protocol, enabling real‑time communication with ASP.NET Core servers. It handles connection negotiation, message sending, and receiving via WebSocket or SSE.
use_when: Implementing real‑time chat or live data feeds
Integrating with ASP.NET Core backends that use SignalR
Building cross‑platform apps needing server push
avoid_when: You only need simple HTTP requests
You prefer a higher‑level abstraction like gRPC or GraphQL
strengths: Platform‑independent, works on mobile, web, and desktop
Handles both WebSocket and SSE transports
Active maintenance with recent bug fixes
weaknesses: No advanced features like automatic reconnection strategies
